disease_state.evidence: We used mass spectrometry-based proteomics to quantify the abundance of 1322 proteins in triceps brachii muscle, encompassing both male and female mice in control and free voluntary wheel running (VWR) in Wild-type (n=3) and FLExDUX4 (n=3) genotypes.

material_type.evidence: Protein extraction and quantification  Muscle samples were ground in liquid nitrogen using the Cellcrusher (Cellcrusher, Cork, Ireland), then homogenized on ice in 10 volumes of 1 % Triton X-100 (v/v), 5 mM NEM, 5 mM EDTA, 50 mM Tris, pH 7.4 including phosphatase inhibitor and complete protease inhibitor cocktails (Roche Diagnostics, Lewes, United Kingdom) using a PolyTron homogenizer (KINEMATICA, PT 1200 E) followed by sonication (FisherbrandTM).
